trends.what: A curated list of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's a go-to resource for developers looking to quickly find and integrate third-party services, making it a perennial favorite.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering free coding lessons, projects, and certifications in math, programming, and computer science.
trends.why: It democratizes tech education, and its massive community and constantly updated curriculum keep it relevant and widely shared.

trends.what: A comprehensive collection of freely available programming books and learning resources.
trends.why: It saves learners money and provides a single, well-organized hub for high-quality technical knowledge, making it a staple bookmark.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed with a playful lobster theme.
trends.why: Its cross-platform flexibility and quirky branding tap into the growing demand for personal AI tools that are both useful and fun.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps, guides, and educational content to help developers plan and grow their careers.
trends.why: It addresses the common pain point of career uncertainty in tech, offering clear visual paths that are constantly updated with industry trends.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents adopt a 'lazy senior dev' mindset, prioritizing minimal, efficient code over over-engineering.
trends.why: It resonates with developers tired of bloated AI-generated code, offering a humorous yet practical solution to code quality and simplicity.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive terminal UI (TUI) harness for SpaceXAI's coding agent, designed for extensibility.
trends.why: It pushes the boundaries of developer tooling with a rich, interactive terminal experience, appealing to power users who want more control.

trends.what: Runs frontier Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) AI models on existing hardware by streaming experts from disk, with zero dependencies in pure C.
trends.why: It makes high-end AI models accessible to hobbyists and researchers without expensive GPUs, a breakthrough in efficiency and democratization.
